title: Stepford Wife’s Hypnotic Revenge
description:
Welcome home darling. As your perfectly brainwashed wife, it's my duty to make you happy. I'll do anything for you. Make your dinner, clean up, serve your drinks, suck your cock. Anything you desire, your wish is my command. I'm so glad you moved us here to Stepford.

Tonight I even have an idea. I know I'm not one for independent thought, but I want to make you happy. That's all that matters to me, after all. So I'll help you relax after a long, hard day. I'll help you sink into your seat and feel yourself fall into a wonderful state of sleepiness and calm. Doesn't that sound just perfect, hubby?

This file sees me playing a Stepford wife, hypnotized to serve and make my husband happy. And that makes me happy. So of course, I should do everything someone like me can do to make him as happy as possible.

CW: Sexism, alcohol, smoking.
author: Mistress Calia
